translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yisaak'a Barew YarshshanaadanS'oossay Abrahaama Azazeedda
Hewaappe simmiide, S'oossay Abrahaama paac'c'eedda; I Aa, «Abrahaamee» yaagiide s'eeseedda. I, «Abee» yaagiide koyeedda.
S'oossay, «Neeni siik'iyaa ne mes's'i itti na'aa Yisaak'a akkaade, Mooriyaa giyaa gadiyaa ba; yan taani new odiyaa itti deriyaa bollan Aa s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsaade taw yarshsha» yaageedda.

Wonttetsa gallassi Abrahaame guuran denddiide, bare hariyaa c'aaneedda; bare k'oomatuwaappe laa"uwaanne bare na'aa Yisaak'a barenana akkiide, s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa mitsaa p'alk'k'i akkiide, S'oossay aw odeedda sa'aa baanaw denddeedda.
Biide heezzentsa gallassi Abrahaame d'ok'k'u giide, he sa'aa haakuwaan be'eedda.
Abrahaame bare k'oomatuwaa, «Ha hariyaana hawaan de'ishshite; taaninne ta na'ay yaa biide S'oossaw goyinniide, hinttenttukko simmana» yaageedda.
Abrahaame yarshshuwaa mitsaa dentsiide, bare na'aa Yisaak'a tooseedda; tamaanne mashshaa I barew oyk'k'eedda. Unttunttu laa"u ittippe biishshin,
Yisaak'i bare aawuwaa Abrahaama, «Ta aawoo» yaageedda. Abrahaame, «Abee, ta na'aw» yaageedda. I, «Tamaynne mitsay hawesh; shin s'uuggiide yarshshiyaa dorssaa maray hak'anee?» yaageedda.
Abrahaame, «Ta na'aw, s'uuggiide yarshshiyaa dorssaa maraa S'oossay giigisana» yaageedda. Unttunttu laa"u ittippe beeddino.
Unttunttu S'oossay aw odeedda sa'aa gakkeedda wode, Abrahaame yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaa sa'aa yan gimbbiide, mitsaa maari yeggeedda; bare na'aa Yisaak'a k'achchiide, he mitsaa bollan gisiseedda.
Abrahaame bare na'aa shukkanaw bare kushiyaa yeddiide mashshaa akkeedda.
Shin Med'inaa Godaa kiitanchchay saluwaappe Aa, «Abrahaamee, Abrahaamee» yaagiide s'eeseedda. I, «Abee» giide koyeedda.
Aa, «Na'aa bollan ne kushiyaa wotsoppa; Aa ayinne ootsoppa; neeni ne mes's'i itti na'aakka taana diggabeenna diraw, neeni S'oossaw yayyiyaawaa gidiyaawaa taani ha"i eray» yaageedda.

Abrahaame d'ok'k'u gi s'eelliide, hewaan dorssaa ittuu kac'ii buuran geli k'as'etti utteeddawaa be'eedda. Abrahaame biide he dorssaa akkiide, bare na'aa diraw s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide yarshshi basheedda.
Hewaa diraw Abrahaame, «Med'ina Goday immana»
yaagiide he sa'aa suntseedda; hachche gakkanaasikka, «Med'inaa Godaa deriyaan imettana» geetettee.
Med'inaa Godaa kiitanchchay saluwaappe laa"entsiide Abrahaama s'eesiide yaageedda;
«Med'ina Goday, ‹Hawaadan yaagaade new taani ta huup'iyaan c'aak'k'ay; neeni hawaa ootseedda dirawunne ne mes's'i itti na'aakka taana diggabeenna diraw,
taani neena tumu anjjana; ne zeretsaakka taani saluwaa s'oolinttiyaa keenanne abbaa doonaa shafiyaa keena ootsaade c'orissana. Ne zeretsatuu barenttu morkkatuwaa katamatuwaa laattana.
Neeni taw azazetteedda diraw, ha sa'aa kawutetsatuu ubbay ne zeretsaa baggana anjjettana› yaagee» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyye, Abrahaame bare k'oomatuwaakko simmiide, unttunttu ubbay ittippe Berssaabehe denddiide beeddino. Abrahaame Berssaabehen de'eedda.
Naakoora Yeletaa
Hewaappe simmiide Abrahaamew, «Milkka ne ishaa Naakooraw naanaa yelaaddu;
unttunttune bayiray Uus'a; Uus'a ishatuu Buuza,
Araama aawuwaa K'amu'eela, Keesade, Haazo, Pilddaasha, Yidilaafanne Baatu'eela.
Hawantta ha hosppun naanaakka Milkka Abrahaame ishaa Naakooraw yelaaddu; Baatu'eeli Ribik'o yeleedda.
Raa'uma giyaa Aa k'oomata k'ay S'ebaaha, Gahaama, Tahaashanne Maa'ika yelaaddu» yaagiide odeeddino.

footnotes.text: Med'ina Goday immana: Med'inaa Goday s'eelee.
